title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: External Root-of-Trust, Verifier Measurement, and Recovery-Checkpoint Extension

parent_binding.extension_rule: Adds bootstrap integrity architecture without changing the predecessor's epistemic ceilings.

problem_statement: If state, receipts and verifier are mutable inside one compromise domain, a forged system can make forged history and forged verification agree. Internal agreement alone is therefore not independent evidence.

new_primitives.STATE_ROOT: Canonical digest or equivalent identity of the complete authoritative state selected by the implementation.
new_primitives.VERIFIER_MEASUREMENT: Identity of the exact verifier implementation and configuration used for admission.
new_primitives.POLICY_SCHEMA_BINDING: Identity of normative schemas and policy version interpreted by the verifier.
new_primitives.EXTERNAL_IDENTITY_CHECKPOINT: Receipt stored outside the mutable subject boundary binding host, state, verifier, policy and sequence.
new_primitives.CHECKPOINT_CHAIN: Ordered linkage preventing silent replacement of a historical checkpoint by a new unrelated root.
new_primitives.RECOVERY_CHECKPOINT: New checkpoint emitted after controlled replay; it never overwrites the compromised historical object.

verification_pipeline: derive current state root from canonical serialization
measure exact verifier and normative policy inputs
locate an external checkpoint outside subject state
compare host, state, verifier, policy and sequence bindings
reject a local PASS when external bindings disagree
recover from last independently attested checkpoint
replay only independently verifiable suffix events

trust_levels.EXTERNALLY_ATTESTED: State/verifier/policy binding matches at least one external witness domain.
trust_levels.INDEPENDENTLY_REPLAYED: A separate verifier reconstructs the admitted result from bound inputs.
trust_levels.TRUE_ABOUT_WORLD: Not derivable from integrity alone; requires evidence appropriate to the world claim.

compatibility_with_identity_architecture.face_lineage: Included inside STATE_ROOT or referenced by it.
compatibility_with_identity_architecture.action_ledger: Included inside STATE_ROOT or referenced by it.
compatibility_with_identity_architecture.obligation_ledger: Included inside STATE_ROOT or referenced by it.
compatibility_with_identity_architecture.evidence_ledger: Included inside STATE_ROOT or referenced by it.
compatibility_with_identity_architecture.quarantine_set: Included so recovery cannot silently erase the fact of prior suspicion.

verification_requirements_for_future_imp: tamper state only and require failure
tamper verifier only and require failure
tamper state and verifier together and require external mismatch
remove checkpoint predecessor and require chain failure
replay from checkpoint and reproduce the accepted suffix
prove suspect suffix remains quarantined when replay evidence is missing
epistemic_boundaries: External attestation is not proof that an autobiographical memory is objectively true.
A cryptographic root is not metaphysical identity.
No machine-consciousness, precognition or mind-over-matter claim is introduced.
canonical_lines: The mirror cannot certify itself merely by agreeing with its own reflection.
Measure the verifier together with the state it verifies.
Integrity is relative to a trust root; truth about the world requires evidence beyond integrity.
